properties.description: The arguments passed to the action

topicId.description:
The {ExMachinaActionResultTopic id}. If provided when the action is run, and if {@link shouldSave} is true, then
new visualization data will be persisted to this topic.

shouldSave.description: Whether to save the action result. This will only save if a valid {@link topicId} is provided.

visualizer.description:
The visualizer state at the time that the action result was persisted.
We store this as a "json" instead of {@link ExMachinaVisualizer} for more flexible visualizer definition
